items.prompt: וַיָּבֹא דָוִד וַאֲנָשָׁיו אֶל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה שְׂרוּפָה בָּאֵשׁ וּנְשֵׁיהֶם וּבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם נִשְׁבּוּ
items.answer: And when David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives and their sons and their daughters were taken captive.

items.prompt: וַיְהִי כִרְאוֹתוֹ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ בִּתִּי הַכְרֵעַ הִכְרַעְתִּנִי וְאַתְּ הָיִית בְּעֹכְרָי וְאָנֹכִי פָּצִיתִי פִי אֶל־יהוה וְלֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב
items.answer: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his garments, and said, Alas, my daughter, thou hast bowed me down to the very ground. Yes, it is thou that art the cause of my calamity; for, as for me, I have made a solemn promise to Yahweh, and I cannot go back (upon it).

items.prompt: עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם
items.answer: Children's children are the crown of old men, and the glory of children are their fathers.

items.prompt: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ
items.answer: Happy are they that dwell in thy house.

items.prompt: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בַּת־פַּרְעֹה וַיְבִיאֶהָ אֶל־עִיר דָּוִד עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ
items.answer: And he took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into the city of David till he had finished building his house.

items.prompt: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעִיר אָבִיו
items.answer: And he slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of his father.

items.prompt: וַיָּקָם מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹשִׁעָן וַיַּשְׁקְ אֶת־צֹאנָם וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל־אֲבִיהֶן וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ מִהַרְתֶּן בֹּא הַיּוֹם
items.answer: And Moses arose and came to their rescue and watered their flock: and when they came to their father, he said, Why have you come (so) quickly to-day?

items.prompt: בְּזִתָנִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אוּרִיָּה לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לְאִשָּׁה
items.answer: Thou hast despised me and hast taken the wife of Uriah to be thy wife.

items.prompt: ועתה לך ואנכי אהיה עם־פיך והוריתיך אשר תדבר
items.answer: And now go, and I, on my part, will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt speak.

data.pointed: וְעַתָּה לֵךְ וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם־פִּיךָ וְהוֹרֵיתִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר

items.prompt: והקמתי את־בריתי אתך ובאת אל־התבה אתה ובניך ואשתך ונשי־בניך אתך
items.answer: And I will establish my covenant with thee, and thou shalt enter into the ark, thou and thy sons and thy wife and thy sons' wives with thee.

data.pointed: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וּבָאתָ אֶל־הַתֵּבָה אַתָּה וּבָנֶיךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ וּנְשֵׁי־בָנֶיךָ אִתָּךְ

items.prompt: Honour thy father and thy mother, as thy God commanded thee.
items.answer: כַּבֵּד אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אִמֶּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוְּךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ

items.prompt: And his daughters spoke to one another, saying: Let us make our father drink wine; and he drank and was drunken.
items.answer: וַתֹּאמַרְנָה בְנֹתָיו אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחֹתָהּ לֵאמֹר נַשְׁקֶה אֶת־אָבִינוּ יַיִן וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיִּשְׁכָּר

items.prompt: And again his wife bore a son; and, when he grew up, he loved his parents with all his heart, and did great good to his brothers and sisters.
items.answer: וַתֹּסֶף אִשְׁתּוֹ לָלֶדֶת בֵּן וַיִּגְדַּל וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־אָבִיו וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ בְּכָל־לִבּוֹ וַיֶּרֶב לְהֵיטִיב לְאֶחָיו וּלְאַחְיוֹתָיו

items.prompt: They took captive their enemies' wives, and plundered their houses, and then went on their way; but they did not slay (מות, Hiph.) any one.
items.answer: שָׁבוּ אֶת־נְשֵׁי אֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ לְדַרְכָּם וְלֹא הֵמִיתוּ אִישׁ

items.prompt: His daughter abode in her father's house two years.
items.answer: יָשְׁבָה בִתּוֹ בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ שְׁנָתַיִם

items.prompt: For two days his father did not open his mouth.
items.answer: יוֹמַיִם לֹא פָתַח אָבִיו אֶת־פִּיו

items.prompt: My father and my mother have forsaken me.
items.answer: עֲזָבוּנִי אָבִי וְאִמִּי

items.prompt: His name shall continually be in my mouth.
items.answer: יִהְיֶה שְׁמוֹ בְּפִי תָמִיד

items.prompt: I have found in thy house vessels of silver and gold.
items.answer: מָצָאתִי בְּבֵיתְךָ כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב

items.prompt: Happy are thy men!
items.answer: אַשְׁרֵי אֲנָשֶׁיךָ
